skill.summary: Use when the user needs to interact with X (Twitter) — searching tweets, looking up users/followers, posting tweets/replies, liking, retweeting, following/un...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the get-user-tweets skill as x-twitter-scraper.
- Provides access to 122 X/Twitter REST API endpoints, including tweet search, user lookup, posting, liking, retweeting, following/unfollowing, DMs, media downloads, and real-time monitoring.
- Includes extensive security, input validation, and payment confirmation measures.
- Requires XQUIK_API_KEY for API access; optional support for HMAC webhooks.
- Reference to up-to-date documentation and pricing at docs.xquik.com.
- For both individual and bulk data extraction, tweet analytics, social media automation, and follower analysis.
